interpretation: This changes the pressure-distribution calculation only. Frame geometry, bolt axes, original elastic shaft solution and the six-case force bank are unchanged.
The finite search preserves every physical receiver force and first moment, along with point forces/couples. Full signed source wrenches remain in the bound rear material report and raw witness map.
An index above one means this constructed finite-grid reference did not clear its declared Fe/5 and Mp/4 comparison. It does not establish that every continuous or compatible pressure field fails.

The separate Fy/2 comparison is evaluated on the selected redistributed witness. Fy is not part of the bearing/hinge optimization objective, so its required value is not a minimum over all possible fields.
The earlier affine radial-pressure reference and this projected line-bearing reference use different constructions. Their indices are not a like-for-like physical strength improvement.

Neither the19 below-one witness states nor the5 flagged states establish whole-joint acceptance or physical failure. Splitting, contact compatibility, group/geometry and complete joint resistance remain open.

method_scope.Fe90_diameter_basis: Nominal fastener diameter for each axis: 12.7 mm for the lumber-leg axes and 9.525 mm for the rail-rear axes. The smaller local root diameter does not increase Fe90 absent a source rule supporting that favorable change. Frozen V1 used local-D Fe90 and remains separately bound; V2 recomputes all 24 states on the nominal-D basis.
method_scope.bearing: Local projected width D(s) times NDS Fe_parallel/Fe90 per receiver cell, divided by 5, in the source-rotated conservative ellipse. Fe_parallel and Fe90 use each axis's source-bound nominal diameter; force and first moment stay aggregate over the physical receiver.
method_scope.ellipse_relation: The reciprocal-strength weighted RMS is no smaller than the Hankinson weighted mean, so the ellipse is no stronger than Hankinson at any load direction.
method_scope.finite_grid: A finite-grid witness index above one is not a lower bound over all continuous fields and does not prove physical failure.
method_scope.matched_mode_basis: For D>=1/4 in and theta<=90 degrees, the pinned NDS Table 12.3.1B reductions are at most 5 (Im/Is), 4.5 (II), and 4 (IIIm/IIIs/IV). Thus Fe/5 is no greater than the bearing term in each applicable matched mode, while Mp/4 is no greater than the hinge term in hinge modes; bearing-only modes have no Mp term. The separately pinned 18-control replay, including 12 hinge-governed controls, has maximum ratio 1.0. This is a conditional matched-mode material reference, not an NDS generalized wrench/group capacity formula.
method_scope.plastic_hinge: Piecewise Fyb*D(s)^3/6/4; matched-mode support is bound to the prior 18-row calibration (12 hinge-governed controls).
method_scope.separate_metal: Independent Fy/2 sufficient envelope is recomputed on each selected witness with actual point-action N/T and continuous lateral V/M extrema; Fy and Fyb remain separate inputs.
